name: Northwind — customer support policy base
description: Billing, refund and escalation policy for support role-plays. Fictional company used for role-play configuration.
out_of_scope_line: I don't know, that's not something I've been told.

passages.text: A duplicate charge is refunded in full on request without approval. Funds clear in three to five business days.
Goodwill credits above the disputed amount — including third-party bank fees — require a supervisor's approval. An agent may not commit to one.
A known billing-retry defect caused duplicate charges on the 4th of the month for a subset of accounts. A fix is scheduled this month. Affected accounts can have a duplicate-detection flag applied.
The Pro plan is 89 per month, billed on the anniversary of signup.
Supervisor callbacks are committed within the same working day. The agent who raised it stays the owner until it closes.
Retention discounts may not be offered by front-line agents. A cancellation intent is logged and routed to the retention team.
Never transfer a customer without explaining why and confirming they are willing. An unexplained transfer is the single largest driver of repeat contacts.
